Case #168

Description

The person in the above photographs wished to augment her naturally petite figure through Breast Augmentation in Kalispell. As a fit, active, 48-year-old woman standing 62 inches tall and weighing 120 pounds, she desired larger breasts to enhance her overall proportion and boost her self-image. Silicone implants with cohesive silicone gel, sized 240cc for both left and right sides, were employed to accomplish her elective procedure.Eight months post-op, she achieved her intended look and feels overjoyed with her fuller figure. This patient hasn't only gained in physical terms but also experienced a boost in her confidence and overall satisfaction with her appearance. Complimenting her active lifestyle, the breast augmentation procedure enhanced her body image and reinforced her self-esteem.The procedure was expertly performed by Michael Hromadka M.D., a board-certified plastic surgeon specializing in Breast Augmentation in Kalispell, Montana. His commitment to achieving natural-looking results for his patients is evident in the above before-and-after images. Dr. Hromadka's expertise in cosmetic surgery, coupled with his skillful surgical techniques and meticulous attention to detail, resulted in an appealing, natural-looking outcome for this patient. Operating from Mountain West Plastic Surgery at 60 Four Mile Drive #11, Dr. Hromadka ensures every patient receives top-notch care and has access to a wide range of cosmetic and reconstructive surgery procedures.
